title: Binary Conversion Challenge
summary: Practice converting between binary and decimal while explaining the positional value of each bit.
objectives: Explain how bit width determines the number of representable values.
instructions: Complete each conversion and show the powers-of-two calculation used.
narratorGuide: Begin by connecting binary digits to on and off states. Model one example, then pause so the learner can solve the challenge independently. Encourage the learner to show their reasoning rather than submitting only final numbers.

tasks.title: Convert binary to decimal
tasks.instruction: Convert 11010 from binary to decimal and show the positional calculation.
hints: Write the powers of two from right to left.
Multiply each bit by its positional value.

tests.explanation: The learner records the decimal value and working.

tasks.title: Convert decimal to binary
tasks.instruction: Convert 27 to binary using the largest power-of-two method.
hints: Subtract each power only when it fits.
Record a 1 for used powers and 0 for unused powers.

tests.explanation: The learner records the binary value and working.
